newsitem.title: USA: Quanex in letter of intent to sell LaSalle.
newsitem.headline: Quanex in letter of intent to sell LaSalle.

text.p: Quanex Corp Thursday said it entered into a non-binding letter of intent to sell its LaSalle Steel Co subsidiary to Niagara Corp.
A Quanex spokesman said terms would not be disclosed until a definitive agreement is reached.

Completion of the sale is subject to due diligence, negotiation of a definitive agreement and the necessary approvals. Completion of the sale is expected within the next 90 days. LaSalle Steel, with plants located in Hammond, Indiana and Griffith, Indiana, is a maker of cold-finished and chrome-plated bars serving the automotive and durable goods markets.
Niagara, with plants in Buffalo, N.Y., Chattanooga, Tenn., and Midlothian, Texas, is also a leading producer of cold-finished steel bars.

Quanex is a leader in the mini-mill manufacture of value-added steel and aluminum products for the transportation, durable goods, capital equipment, home building and remodeling and energy processing markets.
